title: MuSTNet: SAT-based Exact Multi-Stage Transistor Network Synthesis with Placement Awareness
problem: Complex gate synthesis typically focuses on single-stage networks, neglecting multi-stage opportunities and transistor placement, limiting optimization potential.
method: SAT-based exact synthesis framework with multi-stage hierarchy for deeper optimization and placement-aware transistor network minimization for simultaneous count and area reduction.
key_novelty: First multi-stage SAT-based transistor network synthesis incorporating placement constraints.
contributions: Multi-stage hierarchy for deeper functional optimization
21.4% area reduction vs traditional cell-level design
